sources.title: RFC 9345: Delegated Credentials for TLS
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: OCSP：狀態回應的觀測時間與過期證據
related.titleEn: OCSP: observation time and stale status evidence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：1800與900秒可獨立重算，三個結構反例均拒絕；報告把有效時間與可接受憑證分開呈現。 交付delegation-contract.csv、父子有效期圖及演算法負例；只用公開測試材料，不匯出正式簽章金鑰。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 1800 and 900 seconds independently and reject every structural counterexample. Present remaining time and credential acceptability as separate results. Deliver delegation-contract.csv, the parent-child validity timeline and algorithm counterexamples. Use public test material only and never export a production signing key.
related.difference: 建立已撤銷、未知、過期good與新鮮good四類描述；記錄憑證識別、授權回應者與簽章結果，讓應用層能區分狀態拒絕及無法取得可信狀態。
related.differenceEn: Build revoked, unknown, stale-good and fresh-good descriptors. Record certificate identity, authorized responder and signature result so the application can distinguish a negative status from failure to obtain trustworthy status evidence.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 代理驗證包含簽章、演算法與時間要求；本課僅計算已通過其他檢查者的剩餘時間，採父憑證餘期與代理餘期的較小值，不將最小值運算代替協定驗證。 在共同觀測時點，父憑證尚餘7200秒，代理憑證尚餘1800秒；所有描述使用相同UTC時基且在規格允許的期限內。 共同可用時間min(7200,1800)=1800秒；只縮短父餘期至900秒時，變為900秒，不能保留原來的代理餘期結論。

本地課堂政策要求觀測時間不晚於nextUpdate，且thisUpdate年齡不超過900秒；900秒是教學設定，沒有將它宣稱為RFC通用預設。 thisUpdate設為0秒，nextUpdate為1200秒，觀測時刻600秒；將兩條時間限制各自換成相對觀測時刻的剩餘預算。 可用新鮮度餘裕min(1200−600,900−600)=300秒；觀測推進到850秒後餘裕為50秒，仍需先通過身分與簽章檢查。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Delegation requires signature, algorithm and time checks. This exercise calculates remaining time only after the other checks pass, taking the smaller parent and delegated remainder; the minimum operation is not a substitute for protocol validation. At a common observation instant the parent has 7200 seconds remaining and the delegated credential has 1800. Use a shared UTC time base and descriptors within the specification lifetime bounds; do not infer validity from file creation times. The common usable interval is min(7200, 1800)=1800 seconds. Reducing only the parent remainder to 900 makes it 900 seconds; an unchanged delegated descriptor cannot preserve authority beyond its parent.

The classroom policy requires observation no later than nextUpdate and thisUpdate age no greater than 900 seconds. That 900-second bound is a selected local policy, not a universal RFC default or evidence that every responder updates at that rate. Set thisUpdate to zero, nextUpdate to 1200 seconds and observation to 600 seconds. Convert the next-update limit and the local maximum-age limit into separate budgets relative to the observation instant. Freshness margin is min(1200−600, 900−600)=300 seconds. Moving observation to 850 leaves 50 seconds. Positive arithmetic does not authorize a response signed by an unrelated responder.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: BeyondProd：服務身分、來源證據與網段信任拆解
related.titleEn: BeyondProd: separating service identity, provenance and network location
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：1800與900秒可獨立重算，三個結構反例均拒絕；報告把有效時間與可接受憑證分開呈現。 交付delegation-contract.csv、父子有效期圖及演算法負例；只用公開測試材料，不匯出正式簽章金鑰。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 1800 and 900 seconds independently and reject every structural counterexample. Present remaining time and credential acceptability as separate results. Deliver delegation-contract.csv, the parent-child validity timeline and algorithm counterexamples. Use public test material only and never export a production signing key.
related.difference: 畫出前端、API、工作程序與資料服務的呼叫邊；每邊記錄呼叫服務身分、建置證據、使用者脈絡與目標操作，將網段欄保留但不作單獨許可。
related.differenceEn: Draw frontend, API, worker and data-service call edges. Record caller identity, build evidence, user context and requested operation for each edge. Retain subnet as context, while prohibiting subnet membership from independently granting access.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 代理驗證包含簽章、演算法與時間要求；本課僅計算已通過其他檢查者的剩餘時間，採父憑證餘期與代理餘期的較小值，不將最小值運算代替協定驗證。 在共同觀測時點，父憑證尚餘7200秒，代理憑證尚餘1800秒；所有描述使用相同UTC時基且在規格允許的期限內。 共同可用時間min(7200,1800)=1800秒；只縮短父餘期至900秒時，變為900秒，不能保留原來的代理餘期結論。
本地准入規則要求身分與核准來源兩項都成立；使用者操作權限另外評估。集合交集只計服務層通過率，不能解讀為終端使用者都獲授權。 15條合成呼叫邊中12條身分有效，其中9條也有核准來源；另3條身分無效，即使來自內部網段仍拒絕。 服務層通過率9/15×100=60%；補齊兩條既有有效身分邊的來源證據後為11/15×100≈73.333%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Delegation requires signature, algorithm and time checks. This exercise calculates remaining time only after the other checks pass, taking the smaller parent and delegated remainder; the minimum operation is not a substitute for protocol validation. At a common observation instant the parent has 7200 seconds remaining and the delegated credential has 1800. Use a shared UTC time base and descriptors within the specification lifetime bounds; do not infer validity from file creation times. The common usable interval is min(7200, 1800)=1800 seconds. Reducing only the parent remainder to 900 makes it 900 seconds; an unchanged delegated descriptor cannot preserve authority beyond its parent.

The local service gate requires both workload identity and approved provenance. Evaluate end-user operation rights separately. The intersection measures service-layer eligibility only and must not be reported as authorization for every user behind an eligible service. Of 15 synthetic call edges, 12 have acceptable identity and nine of those also have approved provenance. Three invalid-identity edges remain rejected even when their source addresses belong to the internal subnet. Service-layer eligibility is 9/15×100=60 percent. Supplying acceptable provenance for two existing identity-valid edges raises it to 11/15×100, approximately 73.333 percent, without changing the total population.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
